sentences.span: SPX -111bps to 7718, NDX -202bps to 29,950, RTY -193bps to 2729
sentences.why: GS Milhous confirms NDX -202bps to 29,950 and Russell (RTY) -193bps to 2,729 (same figures in 20328). JPM's afternoon briefing (20406) separately confirms the correction status: 'RTY is now 11% below its peak and in a correction.'

sentences.span: CCC spreads around 1,250bp, over 200bp wider since September... the broader issue is whether the cost and availability of capital become prohibitive for lower quality borrowers
sentences.why: Scene-setting transition sentence over the note's credit section, which locates the day's stress specifically among weak, high-borrowing-cost issuers (CCC-rated). Matches the bank's own framing; no figure or attribution of its own to check.

sentences.span: CCC spreads around 1,250bp, over 200bp wider since September... Some of this is idiosyncratic distress in legacy media, cable and building products. ... Not necessarily convinced AI crowding out is driving CCC weakness as that seems more idiosyncratic
sentences.why: Matches CCC level (~1,250bp), widening since September, and the legacy media/cable/building-products distress; the note explicitly disputes an AI/computing driver, supporting 'rather than anything about computing.'

sentences.span: I remain fundamentally bullish on the technology. ... The winners remain those who control scarce compute and scarce capacity.
sentences.why: Direct match to the analyst's stated view.

sentences.span: If credit stress broadens, the implications extend well beyond AI to SMEs, consumers and the broader economy. ... There are a few in the AI vertical with notable increases in CDS that we should be watching.
sentences.why: SMEs = small businesses; CDS (credit default swaps) = cost of default insurance. Conditional framing ('if...broadens') preserved. Published as a Goldman Sachs FICC & Equities note, so bank attribution is correct.

sentences.span: Core goods inflation rose 0.25% m/m, more than triple its 0.07% three-month average
revise our forecast to include a third rate hike in March 2027 after rate hikes in September and December 2026, extending the hiking cycle from two moves... to three
sentences.why: UBS's third-hike add (Sep+Dec 2026 plus Mar 2027) is confirmed in this file, and GS/JPM expecting the second hike in December is confirmed elsewhere (20348: 'the second hike in December'; 20406: 'we still expect the next Fed hike in December'). But no source supports 'market pricing of nearly five in total' — the market-pricing figures found are a 3-hike total (JPM, 20406: 'pricing a Dec hike and then 2x hikes in FY27') or 3 hikes by June 2027 (20254, Natixis). The sentence is grounded in real desk calls but attaches an unsupported aggregate figure.
searched: total number of hikes priced through 2027

sentences.span: CPI (MoM) +0.65% for September vs. GS +0.59%, median forecast +0.6%, prior +0.40%
with energy contributing nearly 40bps to the 65bps monthly gain
Higher oil and jet fuel costs also continued to feed through to travel-related categories, with airfare inflation rising 1.2% m/m
FM and RM were better buyers of USTs across the curve
sentences.why: FM/RM is standard desk shorthand for fast money/real money accounts; 'across the curve' = across maturities. Written in the context of the same day's equity selloff described earlier in the note.

sentences.span: Quality can also be used as a hedge to AI, momentum or beta exposure given the strong negative correlation to these crowded themes. We continue to favor quality (GSP1QUAL), Defensives over Cyclicals... and like shorting... Low Quality Equities... which offers a cleaner rates expression
sentences.why: Direct match on the hedge rationale, the quality/defensives-over-cyclicals preference, and the short low-quality-equities rates expression (Goldman Sachs FICC & Equities).
